cavern.notes: Follow the lower basalt bore through the fissures, or climb to the chimney cache.
cavern.title: Cooling Caverns

chart.notes: A reverse jump from the shaft lip reaches a sealed salvage bay.
chart.title: Shaft Chart Room

chimney.notes: Climb the transfer ladder and jump two rising basalt lips to the survey stash. The lower fissure route leads to the buried module.
chimney.title: Cooling Chimney

crane.notes: Use the upper catwalks to approach the east side of the pump room.
crane.title: Crane Ledges

exit.notes: Unlocked after defeating Kiln Warden. End of Act I at 333.4 m.
exit.title: Act II Gate

flue_cache.notes: Double back above the overflow and breach the service seal for salvage.
flue_cache.title: Vent Service Loft

forge.notes: Two distinct jumps: time the fire jet onto the high apron, then leap down across molten overflow.
forge.title: Forge Approach

furnace.notes: Choose the higher gantry or the floor-level vent lane.
furnace.title: Furnace Lookout

gantry.notes: Climb the west hatch and jump-dash across the gantry. Forge Reactive Liner blueprint.
gantry.title: Upper Gantry

module.notes: Optional module under the second basalt pier. A cracked barrier hides the old core store.
module.title: Field Module Terminal

pump.notes: Use the west hatch for the lower route. The crane ledges run above the sump.
pump.title: Pump Junction

refuge.notes: A ladder on the west side leads to a perch above the boulder.
refuge.title: Runway Refuge

relay_a.notes: Break the locker seal, descend the west ladder and restore the hidden relay. The east shutter opens a return to the fissures.
relay_a.title: Hidden Relay A

relay_b.notes: Cross the sump flue and descend the east boiler hatch. Breach the cracked seal and restore the relay to open the west return.
relay_b.title: Hidden Relay B

repair.notes: Both relays are needed to pass the repair hall and reach the arena.
repair.title: Forge Hall

runway.notes: Bait the boulder, break the bulkhead, then jump the casting drain.
runway.title: Slag Boulder Runway

shaft.notes: Routes rejoin. Alternate wall kicks to reach the service shelf.
shaft.title: Conduit Shaft

sluice.notes: Activate the plate to open the sluice, then cross the lower flue.
sluice.title: Sluice Plate

vent.notes: Time the fire gap, shoot the bleed coupler, then jump the vent. Patch Kit.
vent.title: Lower Vent Lane

warden.notes: Enter the arena and use the purge controls to expose the Warden.
warden.title: Kiln Warden
